scope: Lead accepted all complete EP23 source/share/index summary proposals after reading them. Titles unchanged; saved source/Hant reading follows application.

index.before: 从四分钟一英里到“女子何时超过男子”，极限预测反复把纪录曲线误当成人。尺子能追踪构生产出的数字，却够不到主体的最后刻度。
index.after: 从纪录曲线到生理模型，极限预测需要条件与检验。某些终点已被越过，另一些预测仍待验证；量准成绩，也不等于量尽一个人。

index.before: From the four-minute mile to predictions that women will overtake men, limit forecasts repeatedly mistake record curves for persons. The ruler tracks numbers produced by a system, not the final measure of a subject.
index.after: From record curves to physiological models, predictions of limits need conditions and testing. Some proposed endpoints have been surpassed; other forecasts await testing. Measuring a performance accurately does not exhaust the person who produced it.
